question: For each rating category of the first movie rented by customers—where the first movie is identified based on the earliest payment date per customer—please provide the average total amount spent per customer and the average number of subsequent rentals (calculated as the total number of rentals minus one) for customers whose first rented movie falls into that rating category.
sql:
SELECT 
    fm.rating,
    AVG(p.total_amount) as avg_total_amount,
    AVG(CAST(r.total_rentals AS DOUBLE) - 1) as avg_subsequent_rentals
FROM (
    SELECT 
        p.customer_id,
        SUM(p.amount) as total_amount
    FROM payment p
    GROUP BY p.customer_id
) p
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT 
        r.customer_id,
        COUNT(*) as total_rentals
    FROM rental r
    GROUP BY r.customer_id
) r ON p.customer_id = r.customer_id
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT 
        p.customer_id,
        p.payment_id,
        r.inventory_id,
        i.film_id,
        f.rating
    FROM payment p
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT customer_id, MIN(payment_date) as first_payment_date
        FROM payment
        GROUP BY customer_id
    ) fp ON p.customer_id = fp.customer_id AND p.payment_date = fp.first_payment_date
    INNER JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
    INNER JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
    INNER JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id
) fm ON p.customer_id = fm.customer_id
GROUP BY fm.rating
ORDER BY fm.rating
